name: gitlab
description: Give the agent structured repository and CI facts plus explicitly requested pipeline retry/cancel, while MR review operations stay in mr.

actions.name: repository

repository.description: Optional explicitly selected repository ID or configured host/path.

context.description: Resolved identities and target IDs, retaining known values on failure.

rules: Resolve explicit repository or cwd through repository-context. A missing GitLab remote blocks only GitLab operations, not ordinary Pi work.
Return the observed default branch; never hard-code main or master.
Do not fetch, checkout, modify remotes or create project resources.

actions.name: pipelines

repository.description: Optional explicitly selected repository ID or configured host/path.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from the previous page.

context.description: Resolved identities and target IDs, retaining known values on failure.

rules: Intersect supplied ref/SHA/state filters; do not silently widen them.
Order newest pipeline ID first within the returned page; preserve pipeline source and SHA.
A truncated page is not proof of no matching pipeline.

actions.name: pipeline

repository.description: Optional explicitly selected repository ID or configured host/path.

context.description: Resolved identities and target IDs, retaining known values on failure.

rules: Use the explicit project/pipeline pair; never substitute latest.
Preserve exact ref, SHA and observed state. Terminal and nonterminal states are data, not tool failure.

actions.name: jobs

repository.description: Optional explicitly selected repository ID or configured host/path.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from the previous page.

context.description: Resolved identities and target IDs, retaining known values on failure.

rules: Keep every returned job ID and attempt flag. Default excludes prior retried attempts; include_retried explicitly includes them.
Return allow_failure and state without promoting allowed failures into mandatory failures or vice versa.
Pagination remains explicit.

actions.name: job

repository.description: Optional explicitly selected repository ID or configured host/path.

context.description: Resolved identities and target IDs, retaining known values on failure.

rules: Read the explicitly selected job, including its parent pipeline.
A job from another SHA or pipeline must retain that identity; the caller decides relevance.

actions.name: logs

repository.description: Optional explicitly selected repository ID or configured host/path.

context.description: Resolved identities and target IDs, retaining known values on failure.

rules: Offsets refer to the original trace byte stream; return a bounded UTF-8 decoded window and state if replacement decoding occurred in warnings.
Known credentials are redacted before model-visible output. Returned byte count describes decoded/redacted returned content; next_offset continues the original stream.
Do not write full unbounded logs into a product repository or claim redaction is exhaustive.

actions.name: retry

repository.description: Optional explicitly selected repository ID or configured host/path.

context.description: Resolved identities and target IDs, retaining known values on failure.

ordering: send one retry request when eligible
rules: Require explicit pipeline ID and authorization from the current user task; no approval boolean and no latest inference.
Read target first. Retry eligible failed/canceled jobs through the provider operation, not arbitrary deployment/manual jobs.
If the API confirms no eligible work or no change, report no_change. Return observed pending/running state without claiming eventual success.
Do not automatically repeat after conflict, rate limit or unknown write outcome.

actions.name: cancel

repository.description: Optional explicitly selected repository ID or configured host/path.

context.description: Resolved identities and target IDs, retaining known values on failure.

ordering: send at most one cancellation request
rules: Require explicit selected pipeline and authorized cancel request.
An accepted cancellation response is not proof of terminal canceled state; return observed state and confirmation separately.
An already terminal pipeline is an observed no-op when appropriate. Never cancel another pipeline or all project pipelines.
